title: Diffusion Transformers with Representation Autoencoders
author: Boyang Zheng; Nanye Ma; Shengbang Tong; Saining Xie
summary: The paper shows Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) provide compact, high-quality latents for diffusion transformers. Training on RAE latents speeds convergence and improves FID compared to VAEs or pixel inputs. Using RAEs, DiT models achieve state-of-the-art image generation with much less training time.
